inputs.text: Style: photorealistic restrained cinematic realism. The man keeps his head nearly still and stares forward with both eyes open, his jaw initially relaxed and his lips gently closed. With extremely small amplitude and very slow speed, he tightens his jaw, swallows once so his Adam's apple moves downward, then completes one deliberate slow blink: both eyelids close naturally and reopen together. After reopening his eyes, his gaze slowly lowers toward the bottom of frame while his lips remain closed and still. No tear falls. His exact face, hair, clothing, skin texture and the blurred cool hospital background remain unchanged. The locked camera remains completely static with no pan, tilt, zoom, refocus or shake. A faint fluorescent electrical hum and one quiet breath are heard. No speech.
